FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

North Carolina fishing licence

Anglers aged 16 or older generally need inland or coastal fishing coverage. An inland licence does not cover coastal waters.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers aged 16 or older in public inland waters.
  • Anglers aged 16 or older in coastal waters, unless exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 16 are exempt from fishing licence requirements.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident inland annualnon residentAnnualSee official site
Non-resident inland 10-daynon resident10 consecutive daysSee official site
Non-resident coastal 10-daynon resident10 consecutive days$15 USD
Non-resident coastal annualnon resident12 months$40 USD

Saltwater

Coastal waters require a Coastal Recreational Fishing Licence. Either coastal or inland coverage is valid in joint waters.

Rules visitors should know

  • Licences cannot be transferred.
  • Short-term licences apply only on the specified dates.

How to buy

Use Go Outdoors North Carolina or a Wildlife Service Agent.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in North Carolina?

Anglers aged 16 or older generally need inland or coastal fishing coverage. An inland licence does not cover coastal waters.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in North Carolina?

Non-resident coastal 10-day: $15 USD; Non-resident coastal annual: $40 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in North Carolina?

Use Go Outdoors North Carolina or a Wildlife Service Agent.
